components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; color: #192D4C; border: 1px solid #E9EAEE; border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -6px rgba(25, 45, 76, 0.08); transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 38px -10px rgba(25, 45, 76, 0.14); border-color: #C9A96A; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; padding-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(25, 45, 76, 0.1); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; } .ds-card-sub { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(25, 45, 76, 0.65); margin: 4px 0 0; } .ds-card-num { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 16px; background: #192D4C; color: #C9A96A; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; } .ds-card-body { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; color: rgba(25, 45, 76, 0.85); } .ds-card-rule { display: block; margin-top: 20px; height: 2px; width: 48px; background: #C9A96A; }

narrative.overview: The SRFEC visual system embodies the tension and harmony between rigid industrial engineering (the square frame of measurement, calibration, sawing, and architectural tolerances) and organic geological beauty (the flowing white and gold veins inside natural stone). Surfaces are spacious, calm, and editorial, alternating between Pure White, Warm Cream, and full Granite Navy bands so the craftsmanship and stone imagery carry the authority.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-black material palette anchored in Granite Navy (#192D4C), Soft Champagne Gold (#C9A96A), and Warm Cream (#F5F0E6).
Bilingual typographic parity pairing Playfair Display + Poppins (LTR) with Amiri + IBM Plex Sans Arabic (RTL).
Signature 120px (3px high) Champagne Gold underline beneath every section heading.
Generous 24px (rounded-[24px]) architectural card geometry with navy-tinted elevation shadows.
Horizontally fading <BrandPattern /> texture at 6.5%–7% opacity paired with slow-drifting organic stone-vein contours.

rules.name: The Zero-Black Rule
rules.body: Never use #000000, rgb(0,0,0), or pure black anywhere in text, borders, icons, or box-shadows. Wherever a dark value is required, use Granite Navy (#192D4C).

rules.name: The Gold Contrast Rule
rules.body: Because Champagne Gold (#C9A96A) has low contrast against white, never use small gold body text on white or cream backgrounds.

rules.name: The Unkicked Heading Rule
rules.body: Section headings never carry a small uppercase eyebrow or kicker above them; the serif h2 leads directly and is anchored below by the 120px gold rule.

dos: Do use Granite Navy (#192D4C) for all dark text, dark backgrounds, image overlays, and shadow tints.
Do place the 120px Champagne Gold underline (3px height) directly beneath every section h2 heading.
Do use Tailwind logical properties (ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, start-, end-, text-start) and rtl:rotate-180 on directional arrows.
donts: Don't use #000000 or pure black anywhere in CSS, SVGs, or shadows.
Don't render small Champagne Gold text directly on white or cream backgrounds.
Don't redraw or alter the official SRFEC brand symbol or use exclamation marks and sales superlatives in copy.
